youtube.aciklama: Clear speech is a speaking style deliberately adopted when talking to someone who has difficulty understanding: speech slows a little, short pauses appear between words and sounds are produced more distinctly; shouting is not needed. In the 1985 study by Picheny and colleagues, listeners with hearing loss understood clear speech markedly better; the average difference measured with nonsense sentences was about 17 percentage points. Some later studies found a smaller benefit.
